q: Can you describe a challanging situation you faced and how you handled it?
a:
One challenging situation I faced was starting a new project without knowing whether it would pay off or not. There was no clear roadmap, and I had limited resources and time.

Of course, it was difficult at first, because there was a lot of uncertainty. Instead of feeling overwhelmed, I decided to focus on manageable steps. I made small improvements every day and kept moving forward step by step.

Over time, I started to see progress, which kept me motivated and confident. In the end, I was able to reach my goals and build a project I'm satisfied with.

This experience taught me how to stay consistent and handle uncertainty in a positive way.
